label: Legal Record Updated, Managed Services Not Updated
description: The legal name change is complete and has taken effect. Managed Services still uses the previous name, which is needed for upcoming work. No correction activity exists.

description: The verified Managed Services record already contains Demo Entity Beta LLC, matching the current legal record.

label: Change Does Not Affect Upcoming Work
description: Managed Services still uses the previous name, but upcoming work does not depend on it. No current operational finding is supported.

description: The Managed Service is no longer active. This review covers the service's upcoming work, not any separate legal obligations.

label: Entity Match Cannot Be Confirmed
description: The Managed Services record refers to a different legal entity. Similar names alone cannot confirm that the records belong to the same entity.

label: Available Evidence Is Outdated
